The total capital raised by the company since its establishment in 2022 stands at approximately $140 million. The latest round was led by venture capital funds and investors Ballistic Ventures, Greenfield Partners, Red Dot Capital, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and TLV Partners, along with Yasmin Lukatz and Eyal Waldman. Oligo Security was founded by CEO Nadav Czerninski, CTO Gal Elbaz, and CPO Avshalom Hilu, who are childhood friends and veterans of IDF cyber units in Military Intelligence (Units 81 and 8200) and the C4I Corps (Matzgov). The company currently reports employing about 100 workers, 70 of whom are at its development center in Israel, with the remainder at its offices in New York and San Francisco. ### **Funding growth fuels global expansion** According to the company's announcement, the latest capital raise comes after increasing its annual recurring revenue (ARR) by more than 300% year-over-year, doubling its valuation since its Series B round, and expanding its operations. hits.title: OLIGO Security Raises $60 Million, Bringing Total Funding To $140 Million
hits.snippet: # OLIGO Security Raises $60 Million, Bringing Total Funding To $140 Million By Amit Chowdhry Aug 5, 2026 [Pulse 2.0](https://pulse2.com "Pulse 2.0") OLIGO Security Raises $60 Million, Bringing Total Funding To $140 Million [Follow Pulse 2.0 on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/pulse2news) OLIGO Security has raised $60 million in additional funding, bringing the runtime cybersecurity company’s total funding to $140 million. Participants included Ballistic Ventures, Canon Capital, Greenfield Partners, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Red Dot Capital Partners and TLV Partners. The round also included angel investors such as Mellanox Technologies (acquired by NVIDIA for $6.9 billion) co-founder Eyal Waldman. OLIGO plans to use the capital to accelerate product development, expand its global go-to-market operations and advance its technology for blocking zero-day and known vulnerability exploits in real time. The company provides runtime security across applications, cloud workloads and AI systems. Its platform monitors code while it is executing, helping customers identify vulnerabilities that can actually be exploited and block attacks without disrupting production environments.
